name: C2PA 콘텐츠 자격 증명
description: 확인합니다 for C2PA (Coalition for Content Provenance and Authenticity) content credentials and provenance data. The C2PA standard provides cryptographic proof of content origin and edit history, enabling verifiable chain of custody from capture to publication.
mechanism:
The C2PA verification process involves multiple stages:

1. **JUMBF Container Detection**: Scans the image binary for JUMBF (JPEG Universal Metadata Box Format) superboxes, 는 are the transport mechanism for C2PA manifests.

2. **CBOR Payload Parsing**: 추출합니다 and decodes CBOR (Concise Binary Object Representation) payloads containing claim data, assertions, and credential stores.

3. **AI Action Detection**: Searches for action declarations that indicate AI generation, including `c2pa.created`, `ai_generated`, `trainedAlgorithmicMedia`, and `compositeWithTrainedAlgorithmicMedia`.

4. **Provenance Chain Validation**: Traces the manifest chain to establish origin — whether the image was captured by a compliant camera, edited in a C2PA-aware editor, or generated by an AI tool that declares its output.
parameters:
C2PA 마커: content credentials, manifest store, JUMBF superbox, CBOR containers
AI 액션 유형: c2pa.created, ai_generated, trainedAlgorithmicMedia
지원 카메라: Leica M11, Sony α7/α9 시리즈, Nikon Z 시리즈
accuracy: Very 높음 - 95%+ when C2PA data is present. Currently limited adoption (~5% of all images). As adoption grows (Adobe, Google, Microsoft, BBC), this will become a primary verification method.
source: C2PA Technical Specification 2.0, Content Authenticity Initiative (CAI)
useCase: Primary verification for images from C2PA-compliant sources 와 같은 news organizations, professional photography, and AI platforms that implement content credentials. Essential for media provenance verification in journalism and content moderation workflows.
strengths:
• 출처의 암호학적 증명 — 쉽게 위조 불가
• 촬영부터 게시까지 완전한 편집 이력
• 업계 지원 표준 (Adobe, Microsoft, Google, BBC, Intel)
• AI 생성 및 카메라 촬영 콘텐츠 모두 포괄
• 기계 판독 및 사람 검증 가능
limitations:
• 현재 채택률이 매우 낮음 (이미지의 약 5%)
• 소셜 미디어 공유 시 메타데이터가 삭제될 수 있음
• 촬영/생성 시 C2PA 호환 하드웨어 또는 소프트웨어 필요
• 스크린샷 기반 우회를 방지할 수 없음
• 표준이 아직 발전 중 — 버전 호환성 문제
